calibration_sources: Dean & Barroso 'The Tail at Scale' Speculative Hedged Requests Applied to Multi-Region LLM TTFT
Azure OpenAI PTU (Provisioned Throughput Units) + Pay-As-You-Go Spillover Token-Bucket Economics
LiteLLM / Portkey / Envoy AI Gateway Mid-Stream SSE Prefix Continuation & Cross-Provider Schema Translation

workload_baseline.token_profile: 3,200 input tokens + 600 output tokens, 3.5x peak-to-average diurnal burst

tiers.name: Tier 1: Single-Endpoint Client Exponential Backoff Retry (Wait 2s -> 4s -> 8s on HTTP 429/503)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 单区域客户端指数退避重试 (遇 429/503 硬睡 2s→4s→8s：P99 首字延迟飙至 24.8 秒)
tiers.mechanism: Sends all traffic to one primary endpoint; on HTTP 429 or timeout, sleeps 2^k seconds and retries the same congested region

tiers.name: Tier 2: Reactive Multi-Region Failover After Timeout/429 (Wait 5s Timeout -> Restart Full Prompt from Scratch)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 被动报错后跨区切换 (等 5 秒超时或收到 429 后才切备区 + 流式中断被迫从第 1 个字重算)
tiers.mechanism: Switches to secondary region only after receiving HTTP 429 or waiting 5,000ms TTFT timeout; mid-stream drops restart from token 0

tiers.name: Tier 3: Gateway Local TPM/RPM Token-Bucket Pre-Routing + P95 TTFT Speculative Hedging (850ms Trigger)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 网关本地 TPM 令牌桶预判分流 + 850ms 首字投机对冲 (Speculative Hedging：零等待避开 429)
tiers.mechanism: Tracks remaining TPM/RPM headers locally to route around exhausted quotas in 0.2ms; fires backup hedged request if TTFT > 850ms

tiers.name: Tier 4: Base PTU/vLLM + Proactive TPM Spillover + Mid-Stream Prefix Continuation + Cross-Provider AST Schema Adapter
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 保底 PTU/自建基荷 + 令牌桶主动溢出 + 流式断流前缀续写 (Mid-Stream Resume) + 跨云 Schema 无缝转换
tiers.mechanism: Saturates committed PTU/vLLM at 92% utilization, spills bursts via local TPM buckets, and resumes stalled SSE streams by appending partial output as assistant prefix

failure_perturbation.incident: Daytime 3.5x Traffic Burst (Primary Endpoint Hits 100% TPM Quota Limit)
failure_perturbation.insight: Gateway local token estimator pre-routes overflow at 95% TPM watermark in 0.2ms before any 429 occurs!

failure_perturbation.incident: Silent Upstream Congestion (Primary Region Stalls Without Returning HTTP Error)
failure_perturbation.insight: Tier 4 P95 TTFT speculative hedge fires to Region B at 600ms and cancels the slower stream on first token

failure_perturbation.incident: Mid-Generation SSE Stream Stall at Token 450 / 600 (TCP Reset / Worker Crash)
failure_perturbation.insight: Instead of discarding 450 tokens, Tier 4 appends the 450 tokens as an assistant prefill prefix and resumes token 451!

failure_perturbation.incident: Full Cloud Provider Regional Outage (Failover from Azure/OpenAI to Bedrock/Anthropic or Self-Hosted vLLM)
failure_perturbation.insight: Canonical AST Tool/JSON Schema transpiler translates tool_calls & strict JSON schemas across model families with 0 errors
